Name: Hazael, King of Syria
Summary: Hazael, Elisha's anointed scourge, murdered Ben-Hadad, oppressed Israel through Jehu's and Jehoahaz's days, and died leaving his son Ben-Hadad on the throne.
KeyStory: Hazael murders Ben-Hadad and oppresses Israel.
RelatedPeople: Elisha; Ben-Hadad II, King of Syria; Ben-Hadad III, King of Syria; Jehu, King of Israel; Jehoahaz, King of Israel; Ahaziah, King of Judah; Jehoram, Son of Ahab
LifeLesson: Elisha wept over the cruelty Hazael would do; God uses even cruel kings, and judges them too.
